title_patterns_that_work: Parenthetical validation hooks like '(I Checked)' or '(Proof Inside)'
Direct brand investigation framing (e.g., 'Should You Trust [Brand]?' or 'Does [Brand] Actually Pay...?')
Shorts format performing significantly better than long-form videos for this niche
title_patterns_to_avoid: Vague urgency without strong brand naming
Long-form deep dives without pre-established audience trust (underperforming at 1-3 views)
notes: Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos, with Zocdoc and WeWard generating the highest views (37 and 18 respectively). Content focusing on verifying popular consumer apps and trust/scam elements drives the most engagement.
